title: Detail Brush - VinURL Phantasm Compat
description: Adds Detail Brush compatibility for Phantasm's VinURL disc variant.
body:
Adds [Detail Brush](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/detail-brush) compatibility to [End's Phantasm](https://modrinth.com/mod/ends-phantasm)'s [VinURL](https://modrinth.com/mod/vinurl) compatibility.

This pack is a separate addon due to the fact that Phantasm's compat gets activated automatically if [VinURL](https://modrinth.com/mod/vinurl) is installed. And in case of using [Detail Brush - Modded Disc Compat](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/detail-brush-modded-disc-compat) the disk just becomes the default VinURL disc, overriding the Phantasm's one.
